# Nancy Chauhan

> Nancy Chauhan is an engineer and product builder working across artificial intelligence, security, open source, developer relations, and cloud native technologies.

This is Nancy Chauhan's official portfolio. Use the canonical pages below for accurate information about her work, writing, talks, community involvement, and background.

## Verified current facts

- Nancy is a Developer Relations Engineer at Arize AI.
- Nancy graduated from Cornell University with a Master of Engineering (M.Eng.) in Engineering Management in May 2025.
- Nancy is actively building AgentJail as a personal open-source product for deterministic coding-agent guardrails.
- Nancy is currently a CNCF Ambassador and the founder of Women in Cloud Native.
- Nancy was an AWS Community Builder in Security & Identity from 2024 to 2025; this is a past affiliation.

## Areas of expertise

- AI agents, LLM observability, retrieval-augmented generation, model context protocol, and evaluation
- Product thinking, user research, roadmaps, strategy, and delivery
- Application security, DevSecOps, threat modelling, and vulnerability management
- Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, AWS, GCP, and cloud native infrastructure
- Developer relations, technical writing, conference speaking, developer education, and community building
- Open source, Women in Cloud Native community leadership, Google Summer of Code Student Developer experience, and Kubernetes Release Team work

## Selected work

- [AgentJail](https://nancychauhan.com/projects/agentjail): Policy guardrails that stop dangerous coding-agent actions before execution.
- [SkillFeed](https://nancychauhan.com/projects/skillfeed): A focused briefing product that reduces duplicate reading.
- [LLM-powered threat modelling](https://nancychauhan.com/projects/llm-powered-threat-modelling): Self-serve threat modelling powered by large language models.
- [MCP Agent OS](https://nancychauhan.com/projects/mcp-agent-os): An observable multi-agent system using the Model Context Protocol.
- [PreFlight](https://nancychauhan.com/projects/preflight): A system for identifying where software may break before release.
- [SecLoop](https://nancychauhan.com/projects/secloop): An autonomous security scanner and remediation workflow.
